note: A ball flies at a fixed wall with bounce 1 (minBounceSpeed 0) and leaves at the speed it came with. A box slides on the ground with friction the CollisionCollection does not apply (appliedParameters is BOUNCE only): the engine's 0.5 stops it after v squared over 2 mu g = 1.63 m; X_ITE's Bullet multiplies the friction of the box and of the ground (0.25) and stops it after 3.27 m. Each engine is checked against its own value.
gaps: friction is one Coulomb coefficient for each contact (frictionCoefficients.x, or 0.5 when FRICTION_COEFFICIENT-2 is not applied); X_ITE 16.6.0 multiplies the two bodies' values, so it slides twice as far here (3.27 m against 1.63 m)

X_ITE 16.6.0 sets a body's restitution only if the body's own speed is at least minBounceSpeed when the bounce is configured, and a fixed wall or ground has speed 0, so nothing bounces off it unless minBounceSpeed is 0 (the fixture sets 0); the bridge bounces when the speed of the contact reaches minBounceSpeed
X_ITE 16.6.0 only knows the appliedParameters spelling FRICTION_COEFFICIENT_2, the 4.0 XSD and spec say FRICTION_COEFFICIENT-2, so a valid scene never gets its friction in X_ITE
surfaceSpeed, slipFactors, softnessConstantForceMix, softnessErrorCorrection and the second friction value (rolling friction in Bullet) are kept and not used
collidables is kept and not used: bodies collide through their own geometry, as in X_ITE
